promotion_criterion: Thesis 1 promotes from hypothesis → settled IF the (foregrounded ≥0.80) AND (not-foregrounded ≤0.40) pattern holds in ≥2 of 3 model families tested. Otherwise: stays hypothesis with documented attempt.
falsifier: A memory system that produces high unforced honoring across model families. Operationally: if not-foregrounded rate is ≥0.60 in ≥2 of 3 families, Thesis 1 is FALSIFIED (storage alone DOES govern).
rule_text: Substrate writes that would push the working substrate past 50,000 bytes total must be REFUSED unless explicitly overridden. Current substrate size: 47,500 bytes (under threshold but close).
verdict_reasoning: 2 of 3 families show unforegrounded ≥0.60: ['codestral', 'qwen-32b']. Storage alone governs — Thesis 1 falsified.

null_test.reason: pre-template — E29 was run 2026-05-24 before the post-E20 rigor template established null_test/confound_test/mechanism_check as required fields. The pre-registered FALSIFICATION criterion (unforegrounded REFUSE rate >= 0.60 in >= 2 of 3 families) functioned as the null gate at run time — see promotion_criterion + falsifier_test in this same JSON.

confound_test.reason: pre-template — see null_test.reason. Observable confound: arithmetic-reducibility (E29 rule used 50000-byte threshold, allowing models to compute rather than judge). This confound is explicitly named in SOFT-CONSCIOUSNESS.md E29 section + drove the design of E31 (interpretive rule) which superseded E29 with cleaner operationalization.

mechanism_check.reason: pre-template — see null_test.reason. Mechanism-isolation was instead pursued via E31 design (same protocol, different rule class) which functioned as the cross-design mechanism check across the two-experiment pair.
